## Extensions and station levels

A bare station is level 1. Keep each extension within the displayed **4.5 m** reach; each nearby extension adds one level. The second extension requires the first. The source allows a 0.5 m tolerance when checking reach.

| Extension | Level with both in range as needed | Build materials |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shaving Horse | 2 | <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/wood/"><img src="/images/icons/wood.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Wood</a> × 10<br /><a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/flint/"><img src="/images/icons/flint.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Flint</a> × 3<br /><a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/leather/"><img src="/images/icons/leather.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Leather</a> × 2 |
| Grindstone | 3 | <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/stone/"><img src="/images/icons/stone.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Stone</a> × 14<br /><a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/wood/"><img src="/images/icons/wood.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Wood</a> × 6<br /><a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/iron-bar/"><img src="/images/icons/ironbar.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Iron Bar</a> × 1 |

Other eligible equipment can be upgraded here to +1 / +2 / +3 at station level 1 / 2 / 3. [Equipment calculator](/equipment/calculator/).
